content.title: March Madness bracket updates: Miami (Ohio) and Prairie View A&M complete men's Round of 64, first round begins Thursday
content.text: The men’s and women’s NCAA basketball tournament brackets are official, and the first-round schedule is set.The start of the First Four on Tuesday did not disappoint as Howard delivered its first NCAA tournament win and then Texas held off NC State on a last-second jumper by Tramon Mark. The men’s tournament First Four continued on Wednesday with No. 16 Prairie View A&M and No. 11 Miami (Ohio) locking up the final spots in the Round of 64. The women’s First Four will wrap up on Thursday.AdvertisementThe men’s tournament is led by Duke as the No. 1 overall seed playing out of the East region, with Arizona, Michigan and Florida as the other top seeds. Duke’s Cameron Boozer got great news on Tuesday as he was named a first-team AP All-American along with two other freshmen. (The big news early in the week was the arrest of Alabama star Aden Holloway after police allegedly found 2.1 pounds of marijuana at his residence.)Yahoo Bracket Mayhem: Make your picks for $50K in total prizes | Printable bracketOn the women’s side, UConn, UCLA, South Carolina and Texas secured the No. 1 seeds in the women’s bracket, with UConn sitting as massive -275 odds favorites to win it all — the shortest pre-tournament odds of any team this decade.Follow along with the latest men's and women's NCAA basketball tournament news and updates leading up to the start of the first round.Live coverage is over48 updatesThu, March 19, 2026 at 12:37 PM UTCJeff EisenbergAfter all the consternation about Miami (Ohio) and its inclusion in the tourney field, they shut down the doubters with a win over fellow No. 11 SMU in the First Four.Read more from Jeff Eisenberg right here.Thu, March 19, 2026 at 12:57 AM UTCYahoo Sports StaffDontae Horne and Cory Wells were just too much for Lehigh. Horne had 25 points, 7 rebounds and 4 steals. Wells added 19 points and 11 boards.It’s the first-ever win in the NCAA tournament for Prairie View A&M. The Panthers are on to the Round of 64 to face Florida in the South region first round.Wed, March 18, 2026 at 8:02 PM UTCTarohn FinleyA bad virus has sidelined ASU women’s basketball coach Molly Miller. She did not make the trip to Iowa City with her team, which plays Virginia on Thursday. She hopes to join her players when her health improves— Cronkite News: Phoenix Sports (@sportscronkite) March 18, 2026Wed, March 18, 2026 at 7:09 PM UTCTarohn FinleySiena head coach Gerry McNamara told reporters on Wednesday that he is focused on the Duke game on Thursday, despite rumors tying him to the Syracuse head coaching vacancy.“I think with what we did (this season), with the job obviously being open, it was inevitable, with my history there, just coming from there,” McNamara said. “I will reiterate again, my full focus is on the team in that locker room that has an opportunity to play against the best team in the country.”McNamara led Siena to a 23-11 record, the MAAC tournament championship, and the team’s first NCAA appearance since 2010 in his second season as head coach. Before going to Siena, McNamara was on Syracuse’s staff since 2009.He also played for the Orange from 2002 to 2006, where he won the national championship in 2003 alongside Carmelo Anthony. Anthony’s son, Kiyan, now plays at Syracuse.McNamara has been one of the names linked to the job, along with former Orange assistant coach and Washington head coach Mike Hopkins. USF head coach Bryan Hodgson reportedly turned down the Syracuse job. Syracuse fired former head coach Adrian “Red” Autry and his staff after a 15-17 season and no tournament appearances in his three seasons as head coach. Syracuse also recently hired Bryan Blair as AD.Despite Duke heading into the NCAA Tournament as the No. 1 overall seed after a 32-2 season and an ACC Tournament championship, the team is expected to be without starters Caleb Foster and Patrick Ngongba II.Wed, March 18, 2026 at 6:02 PM UTCKate MagdziukDuke will likely be without starting center Patrick Ngongba II for their first-round matchup against Siena in this year’s NCAA men’s tournament.Coach Jon Scheyer provided an update on the starter on Wednesday, stating that although Ngongba is progressing in his return from injury, it’s “unlikely” he plays in the team’s opening matchup.The 6-foot-11 big man has been sidelined since early March with a foot injury, averaging 11.4 points, 6.5 rebounds and 2.1 assists per game this season.Wed, March 18, 2026 at 4:45 PM UTCMorten Stig JensenFor months, the projected top three of the 2026 NBA Draft has been firmly established: AJ Dybantsa, Darryn Peterson and Cameron Boozer.Whichever way they're ranked boils down to personal preference, but that trio is widely considered to comprise the first three names being called in June.However, someone is knocking on that door and trying to get in.Darius Acuff Jr., the 6-foot-3 lead guard out of Arkansas, is reaching the point where he is becoming outright undeniable.Read more on Acuff’s ascention toward top consideration in this year’s NBA draft.Wed, March 18, 2026 at 3:18 PM UTCKate MagdziukLouisville will be without one of its top scorers in the first round of the NCAA men’s basketball tournament, as Mikel Brown Jr. has been ruled out with a back injury.Louisville will be without star freshman Mikel Brown Jr. in the opening weekend of the NCAA tournament, the school announced. He's been dealing with a back injury and will not play against No. 11 South Florida and will also not play if Louisville advances.— Pete Thamel (@PeteThamel) March 18, 2026Brown Jr. is averaging 18.2 points per game over 21 contests this season, only behind guard Ryan Conwell, who leads the team at 18.7.Louisville is slated to face No. 11 South Florida in the first round on Thursday at 1:30 p.m. 11 Miami (OH) vs. No. 11 SMU: 9:15 p.m. ET on TruTVWed, March 18, 2026 at 4:13 AM UTCYahoo Sports StaffWed, March 18, 2026 at 3:41 AM UTCYahoo Sports StaffWed, March 18, 2026 at 1:02 AM UTCYahoo Sports StaffTue, March 17, 2026 at 11:44 PM UTCDan WolkenThe idea to make Jai Lucas the youngest coach at the power conference level began with recruits Miami didn’t even land.As athletic director Dan Radakovich and his small search committee surveyed the landscape a little more than a year ago, knowing the next Miami coach would inherit a program that had sunk to the bottom of the ACC in Jim Larrañaga’s final years and would need a complete roster overhaul, there were two paths.Miami could wave millions of dollars at an experienced coach or make a strategic bet on a 37-year-old who had been responsible for Duke’s recruitment of the Boozer twins from nearby Columbus High School, had been ingrained in the complex landscape of NIL and would not command a huge salary right away.“The Boozer twins [were already headed to Duke], but could somebody continue to have that kind of relationship with young people given the world we live in right now?” Radakovich told Yahoo Sports. “When you have coaches my age or Coach Larrañaga’s age, you have to reprogram yourself. These folks are just getting programmed, and that’s where I thought Jai was going to really shine.”He has. Among all the teams that qualified for the NCAA tournament as an at-large, few have been more surprising than Miami, which earned a No. 7 seed in the West regional after going 25-8 in Lucas’ first season.Read the full story here.Tue, March 17, 2026 at 10:35 PM UTCFollow along with all the action here as UMBC takes on Howard at 6:40 p.m. ET, and Texas faces NC State in the nightcap at 9:15 p.m. ET. Both games will be broadcast on truTV.Tue, March 17, 2026 at 9:43 PM UTCRyan YoungMillions of fans across the country are filling out their brackets ahead of the men’s and women’s NCAA tournaments this week.But who are they picking to win it all? And are they worth listening to as you fill out yours?Here’s a breakdown of who Yahoo Sports users are selecting so far in their NCAA tournament brackets.Tue, March 17, 2026 at 9:26 PM UTCTue, March 17, 2026 at 6:52 PM UTCYahoo Sports StaffBased on the public data from Yahoo Sports' Bracket Mayhem, 30% of brackets picked Duke as champion. So if you pick Duke and the Blue Devils win it all, then you and plenty of other people get those 32 points for picking the champion, which is the most important choice in your bracket. With so many people in contention, it's likely that one of those people is going to make some outrageous choices in earlier rounds and beat you.Instead, you want to make a contrarian choice and pick against the favorite Duke. You find a team with a high win probability but that isn't getting picked by others in your pool.Read more from Ed Feng right here.Tue, March 17, 2026 at 6:12 PM UTCYahoo Sports StaffVia AL.com:Police found a little over 2 pounds of marijuana in Alabama basketball guard Aden Holloway’s apartment on Monday morning, according to court records obtained by AL.com.Drug agents serving a search warrant said they found loose marijuana, a vacuum sealed bag with marijuana, a rolling tray and packaging material, according to the deposition and charge sheet obtained by AL.com on Tuesday.“Holloway stated that he wanted to remain silent, but then stated that he only smokes,” an agent from the West Alabama Narcotics Task Force wrote in court records.Tue, March 17, 2026 at 5:36 PM UTCYahoo Sports StaffHeadlined by BYU’s AJ Dybantsa and Duke’s Cameron Boozer, three freshmen made the AP All-American First-Team.Tue, March 17, 2026 at 5:28 PM UTCYahoo Sports StaffCan you trust defending champion Florida this year? What about UConn after it got throttled by St. John’s in the Big East championship?Although changes to the college basketball landscape have made things easier for the chalk in recent years, it doesn’t mean the higher seeds are auto-picks to win games over the next three weeks. We always have to be mindful of high-profile schools that might be ripe for picking off, and today we’ll discuss four signature programs (hitting on a 1, 2, 3 and 4 seed) that could fit that profile.Read more from Scott Pianowski right here.
